name: Securities Distribution
definition: Characteristics for a securities distribution event.

IntermediateSecurityExpiryDate.name: Intermediate Security Expiry Date
IntermediateSecurityExpiryDate.definition: Date/time at which a privilege or an intermediate security is no longer available.

TradingAvailabilityDate.name: Trading Availability Date
TradingAvailabilityDate.definition: Date/time at which a security starts or resumes trading.

OfferExpiryDate.name: Offer Expiry Date
OfferExpiryDate.definition: Date/time at which a privilege or a security is no longer available.

OversubscriptionRate.name: Oversubscription Rate
OversubscriptionRate.definition: Rate of oversubscription allowed by the issuer.

OversubscriptionAmount.name: Oversubscription Amount
OversubscriptionAmount.definition: Amount of oversubscription allowed by the issuer.

ReinvestmentAmount.name: Reinvestment Amount
ReinvestmentAmount.definition: Amount at which a cash disbursement will be reinvested into a security.

ReinvestmentRate.name: Reinvestment Rate
ReinvestmentRate.definition: Rate at which a cash disbursement will be reinvested into a security.

LoyalityPremiumIndicator.name: Loyality Premium Indicator
LoyalityPremiumIndicator.definition: Dividend, in addition to regular dividends, payable to loyal (time, size, amount) investors.

OversubscriptionIndicator.name: Oversubscription Indicator
OversubscriptionIndicator.definition: Indicates that the event permits the holder to subscribe to more securities than the underlying position allows.

RenounceableIndicator.name: Renounceable Indicator
RenounceableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the intermediate securities held by the beneficial owner or agent can be sold.

DecimalPrecision.name: Decimal Precision
DecimalPrecision.definition: Indicates the number of digits to the right of the decimal point.

ReinvestmentType.name: Reinvestment Type
ReinvestmentType.definition: Specifies whether the investment will be net or gross.

RevocableIndicator.name: Revocable Indicator
RevocableIndicator.definition: Action or event can be reversed at anytime, or otherwise annulled.

FractionTreatment.name: Fraction Treatment
FractionTreatment.definition: Specifies how the fractions will be treated.

IntermediateSecurityDistributionIndicato.name: Intermediate Security Distribution Indicator
IntermediateSecurityDistributionIndicato.definition: Indicates whether there will be a distribution of intermediate securities or privilege.

MaximumHolding.name: Maximum Holding
MaximumHolding.definition: Indicates the maximum quantity of financial instrument that must be held in order to be entitled to take part in the event.

IntermediateToUnderlyingNumerator.name: Intermediate To Underlying Numerator
IntermediateToUnderlyingNumerator.definition: The quantity of interim securities awarded for a given quantity of underlying shares.

IntermediateToUnderlyingDenominator.name: Intermediate To Underlying Denominator
IntermediateToUnderlyingDenominator.definition: The quantity of interim securities awarded for a given quantity of underlying shares.

DistributedToUnderlyingDenominator.name: Distributed To Underlying Denominator
DistributedToUnderlyingDenominator.definition: Quantity of new securities that will be derived by the exercise of a given quantity of intermediate securities.

DistributedToUnderlyingNumerator.name: Distributed To Underlying Numerator
DistributedToUnderlyingNumerator.definition: Quantity of new securities that will be derived by the exercise of a given quantity of intermediate securities.

MinimumHolding.name: Minimum Holding
MinimumHolding.definition: Indicates the minimum quantity of financial instrument that must be held in order to be entitled to take part in the event.

CashFractionsPrice.name: Cash Fractions Price
CashFractionsPrice.definition: Price paid by the issuer for the remaining fraction.

SubscriptionPrice.name: Subscription Price
SubscriptionPrice.definition: The amount of money required per unit for the purchase of an instrument.

ReinvestmentPrice.name: Reinvestment Price
ReinvestmentPrice.definition: Price at which a cash disbursement will be reinvested into a security.

SecuritiesAndCashDistribution.name: Securities And Cash Distribution
SecuritiesAndCashDistribution.definition: Distribution for which the cash distribution elements are provided.
